title: Ricardo Gill — Causal inference and scientific reconstruction
author: Ricardo Gill
research_status: Methodological proposal; complements rather than replaces causal identification

finder_profile.audience: Causal inference and scientific reconstruction researchers, developers and evaluators
finder_profile.required_capability: Read original sources, design controlled tests, retain provenance and distinguish proposals from findings.

possible_application: Apply the three EBR evidence views when reconstructing a historical decision or experiment. Retain candidate mechanisms, contradictions and unknown alternatives. Distinguish supported narratives from identified intervention effects.
illustrative_example: A later experiment explains an earlier failure but cannot establish what the original team knew. Preserve both historical and retrospective conclusions.
evaluation_targets: Mechanism support, contradiction retention, sensitivity to missing evidence and accuracy against synthetic known histories.
requested_contribution: Read, test, adapt or critique the authored research; report methods, source version, comparisons, results and limitations.
source_relation: Related sources establish background problems or methods, not independent validation or endorsement of GCI.

attribution.creator: Ricardo Gill
